lines.text: You could never buy the Eiffel Tower. In 1925, one man lost a fortune trying. Why did he stay silent?
chunks: You could never buy the *Eiffel Tower.*
lines.chapter: SHORT: THE MAN WHO SOLD THE EIFFEL TOWER

lines.text: The tower was only meant to stand 20 years. By 1925, it was rusting and costly.
chunks: The tower was only meant to stand *20 years.*
lines.chapter: SHORT: THE MAN WHO SOLD THE EIFFEL TOWER

lines.text: So con man Victor Lustig got fake government letterhead, and invited scrap dealers to a luxury hotel.

and invited scrap dealers to a *luxury hotel.*

lines.text: His pitch: the state will sell the tower for scrap. Top secret.

lines.text: Dealer André Poisson paid, plus a bribe, and Lustig vanished with the cash.

lines.text: And that's not even the craziest part.
